command:
set +e
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e (spawn#707).
set -uo pipefail
P="${CONDA_PREFIX:-/opt/conda}"
export PATH=$P/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp LC_ALL=C OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 PLUMED_NUM_THREADS=1 PLUMED_KERNEL=$P/lib/libplumedKernel.so
mkdir -p /tmp/out /tmp/w && cd /tmp/w
# Where does a 200-frame `plumed driver` spend its 1.5 s? Same input, with and without MPI_Init.
# One cohort trajectory, checked against its pinned sha256 in the cohort manifest.
python3 -u - <<'PYEOF' > /tmp/out/startup.txt 2>&1
import hashlib, subprocess, tarfile, time, urllib.request, resource
n = "NALAALAALAALACALA-R2.tar.bz2"
d = urllib.request.urlopen("https://toyokounqpeptides.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/5pep/" + n, timeout=60).read()
print(n, hashlib.sha256(d).hexdigest())
open(n, "wb").write(d); tarfile.open(n).extractall(".", filter="data")
subprocess.run(["cpptraj", "-p", "p.1.top", "-y", n[:-8] + ".dmd.1.traj", "-x", "x.dcd"], capture_output=True, check=True)
open("p.dat", "w").write("phi: TORSION ATOMS=11,13,15,21\nPRINT ARG=phi FILE=COLVAR FMT=%.10f\n")
for mode in ["mpi", "no-mpi", "mpi", "no-mpi"]:
    pre = [] if mode == "mpi" else ["--no-mpi"]
    u0 = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN); t0 = time.time()
    for i in range(20):
        p = subprocess.run(["plumed"] + pre + ["driver", "--mf_dcd", "x.dcd", "--plumed", "p.dat"], capture_output=True, text=True)
        assert p.returncode == 0, p.stdout[-300:] + p.stderr[-300:]
    t = time.time() - t0; u1 = resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    cpu = (u1.ru_utime - u0.ru_utime) + (u1.ru_stime - u0.ru_stime)
    print("%-7s per run: wall %.3f s  cpu %.3f s  COLVAR %s" % (mode, t / 20, cpu / 20, hashlib.sha256(open("COLVAR", "rb").read()).hexdigest()[:16]))
for pre in ([], ["--no-mpi"]):
    t0 = time.time(); subprocess.run(["plumed"] + pre + ["info", "--version"], capture_output=True)
    print("plumed %s info --version: %.3f s" % (" ".join(pre), time.time() - t0))
PYEOF
cat /tmp/out/startup.txt
